# Concordio Core

> A static, offline, open-licensed Bible dataset: five translations keyed by OSIS verse id, plus 3,067 people, 1,298 places and 450 events linked to the verses that name them. No server, no API key; read the JSON files directly.

Start with `web/data/packs/index.json`, then each pack's `manifest.json`. Verses are keyed `Book.chapter.verse` (e.g. `John.3.16`). Never invent an entity-to-verse link the data does not contain; join on `slug` or `id`, never on display name. The two large interlinear packs (Hebrew/Greek words with Strong's numbers) are release artifacts, not in the git tree; `web/data/samples/` holds short samples and `make fetch-release TAG=<tag>` fetches the full packs.
